svg.text: Chit redraw sheet: Battle assets: artillery, rocket artillery, engineers, armor and infantry (57 chits)
LEFT: the graphic the game uses now (group "old-..."; locked reference, delete it when done). RIGHT: draw the new chit inside the dashed square (group "art-...").

Draw the printed chit at 200 x 200 with rounded corners as it should look. Leave the turn-number corner (top-left) free where the old art has one: the game adds the turn. Convert text to outlines before sending.
One square per distinct chit; the notes under it say how many copies exist and when they arrive. Delete the "notes-..." groups when you are done.
